Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Stack: C++ (MinGW), Go, TypeScript + React. Pipeline: Windows App → C++ DLL → JSON files → Go Native Host → Browser Extension → Gmail API. Privacy/local-first: data stays local, app works offline, external API calls only when necessary. Prefer free services; ship pragmatically. TypeScript strict mode is required.

Keep related code together; minimize file splitting/bloat; colocate code. Use React Bootstrap, Radix UI, or similar. Avoid utility-first CSS: No Tailwind. Prefer semantic, maintainable markup. The project should be ready for translations from the start. Use message catalogs or i18n libraries for user-facing strings. Technical documentation remains in English.

Build: `npm run build` (or individual `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`). Test: `npm run test`.

Interceptor (`src/interceptor/`): capture MAPI calls to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Target Simple MAPI spec only (not Extended MAPI/COM). Zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json - hand-rolled JSON). Non-blocking - return immediately to caller. Thread-safe - multiple apps may call simultaneously. Always test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Test Explorer, PDF viewers, etc.; check memory leaks and thread safety. `main.cpp` exports MAPI; `mapi_impl.cpp` implements MAPISendMail; `json_writer.cpp` serializes; `fs_utils.cpp` handles files.

Native Host (`src/native-host/`): bridge filesystem to extension via Chrome Native Messaging (length-prefixed JSON): `{"type": "email", "id": "...", "data": {...}}`, `{"type": "removed", "id": "..."}`, `{"type": "ready", "version": "1.0.0"}`, `{"type": "process", "id": "..."}`, `{"type": "delete", "id": "..."}`. `main.go` loop; `protocol.go`; `watcher.go` uses fsnotify. Run `gofmt` before committing. Test native messaging with the extension. Handle filesystem edge cases (deleted files, permission errors).

Extension (`src/extension/`): React 18, React Bootstrap, Vite, TypeScript; Chrome Identity API for OAuth. `manifest.json`; `src/background/service-worker.ts`; `src/popup/App.tsx`; `src/types/messages.ts`. Use React Bootstrap components for UI. Keep service worker minimal - offload to popup when possible. Test in both Chrome and Edge.

JSON files: `%TEMP%\go-mapi\*.json`; schema [docs/json-schema.json](docs/json-schema.json). Comment the "why", not the "what". Document non-obvious constraints. Keep comments concise. Use Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`.

Workflow: understand component; read source; check/run tests; identify related files. Follow patterns; keep changes minimal and focused; add tests; update documentation if behavior changes. Run `npm run build`; run `npm run test`; test manually if changing user-facing behavior.

Schema: update `docs/json-schema.json`, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TypeScript types in `src/extension/src/types/`, and Go structs in `src/native-host/`. Settings: add Chrome storage setting, UI, service-worker read, persist with `chrome.storage.sync`.

Verify: build all components: `npm run build`; register DLL (admin): `npm run register:mapi`; load extension in Chrome/Edge developer mode; check `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`; check extension DevTools. Use MinGW, React Bootstrap, and JSON files in `%TEMP%`.
